tour.name: Ross's Landing
tour.blurb: The 1815 riverfront landing where Chattanooga began.

tour.name: Tennessee Aquarium
tour.blurb: Opened 1992 — the world's largest freshwater aquarium at the time.

tour.name: Walnut Street Bridge
tour.blurb: 1890 truss bridge, 2,376 ft — one of the longest pedestrian bridges in the world.

tour.name: Coolidge Park
tour.blurb: North Shore park with a 1894 Dentzel carousel and a climbable fountain.

tour.name: Republic Centre
tour.blurb: At 300 ft / 21 floors, Chattanooga's tallest building — the downtown skyline's anchor.

tour.name: Downtown Core
tour.blurb: The Broad & Market Street grid — the dense heart of downtown, laid out in 1839.

tour.name: Chattanooga Choo Choo
tour.blurb: Historic Terminal Station (1909), immortalized by the 1941 Glenn Miller hit. Now a hotel + gardens on the Southside.
